name: qp_workingset_refinement_diag_v1

rules.enter: largest positive b-Ax among ALL inactive coordinates; ties lowest original index
rules.leave: minimum feasible line-search ratio for negative stationary variables; ties lowest index
rules.solve: numpy.linalg.solve(A_WW,b_W); exact binary64 inputs, no matrix modification
rules.singular_policy: LinAlgError or nonfinite condition number => SINGULAR_WORKING_SET_UNRESOLVED
rules.refinement: up to 3 corrections using binary64 solve and Decimal80 residual; no pseudoinverse
rules.cycle: repeat of identical working-set and binary64 x bytes => CYCLE_DETECTED
rules.acceptance: full float64 AND Decimal80 project KKT <=1e-8
rules.already_float64_pass: return original x unchanged; report precision mismatch rather than alter it

best_trust: minimum recomputed KKT; first index on ties; start only, never acceptance
regression: same refinement on original standard 30k x; F1 standard result regenerated using untouched v4 solver
regression_trigger: B58 x_standard refinement passes both checkers
old_standard_pass: return exact original x without a linear solve
constraints: All original coordinates checked, no permanent removal
matrix: Use original unsymmetrized binary64 A in solves/KKT; symmetric part used ONLY for spectral reporting
precision: Decimal 80 decimal digits, Decimal.from_float on original binary64 values
